name: Buddy Target Op Set v1
description: Versioned Transformer and MoE seed; measured workload gaps are reported separately, never silently added.
denominator_rule: Unique namespace::operator.overload keys across families. All untested, failed and limited entries stay in the denominator.

removed.fill_cache.default: Buddy-specific KV helper, outside ATen/Prim scope
removed.update_cache.default: Buddy-specific KV helper, outside ATen/Prim scope

migration_from_v0.note: v0 and v1 percentages are not directly comparable. v0 retained for historical reference.

transformer_core.description: Dense Transformer / LLM decode-prefill building blocks

moe_critical.description: MoE routing, top-k, expert dispatch/combine, scatter/gather, dynamic index

vision_transformer_extra.description: ViT / multimodal extras beyond dense LLM core

known_partial_or_limited.aten::topk.default: linalg.py:topk_op requires static shapes and a static integer k; complex types are rejected.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::scatter.reduce: Review pending: Reduce mode / dtype coverage may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::scatter_reduce.two: Review pending: Reduce mode / dtype coverage may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::index_put.default: Review pending: Accumulate / advanced indexing may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::index.Tensor: Review pending: Advanced indexing / None / boolean masks may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::_scaled_dot_product_flash_attentio: tosa.py:scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_for_cpu_op asserts dropout_p == 0 for explicit dropout arguments.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::one_hot.default: Configured explicit-num_classes=4 cases pass through AOT decomposition after the bool-to-integer copy fix. Inferred class counts, empty inputs and invalid indices remain untested.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::bincount.default: The cpu-export-v1 cases fail during AOT import with DynamicOutputShapeException; minlength does not fix the data-dependent output extent.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::argsort.default: Configured default-attribute cases pass through AOT SortOp. Other dimensions, descending order and non-contiguous inputs remain untested.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::index_add.default: The cpu-export-v1 cases fail during Buddy import with KeyError: index_add.default.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::index_copy.default: The cpu-export-v1 cases fail during Buddy import with KeyError: index_copy.default.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::contiguous.default: Review pending: May be elided or cloned depending on strides; requires layout-specific cases.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::reshape.default: Configured contiguous cases pass through AOT ViewOp. Non-contiguous reshape semantics remain untested.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::softmax.int: Configured last-dimension cases pass through AOT SoftmaxOp. Other dimensions and optional output dtype remain untested.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::pad.default: Review pending: General padding modes are not established by a constant_pad_nd mapping.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::pixel_shuffle.default: Review pending: Vision path; may be unsupported.
known_partial_or_limited.aten::pixel_unshuffle.default: Review pending: Vision path; may be unsupported.
